title: Dermatoses, Erosive or Ulcerative

content_blocks.text: A heterogenous group of skin disorders characterized by disruption of the epidermis (erosions) or, if the basement membrane is compromised, the epidermis and dermis (ulcers).

Varies widely, depending on the cause; may include congenital or developmental disorders that compromise tissue cohesion; cell-mediated (inflammatory or neoplastic) injury; anoxic injury; antigen-specific auto-immune disorders; and necrosis due to trauma, toxins, contactants (irritants), microbial organisms, or parasitic migration.
Some diseases are likely heritable due to breed predilections; however, there are no genetic screening tests available for any of the diseases listed.
